name: Tyrant Fang
body:
Your bite can crack anything.

Prerequisite(s): Vital Strike or spell strike class feature, bite attack.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use the Vital Strike feat or spell strike class feature with a bite attack, your bite attack is considered 1 size larger when determining its damage (this does not stack with other such size increases, such as the impactue weapon quality).
